notes.title: Save the Galaxy, Support Our Community
notes.notes:
We at King Crow Studios are excited to announce our newest game HIVE SLAYER is now available on Steam and Itch.io for VR headsets. HIVE SLAYER mixes classic quarter machine arcade gameplay with the power of VR to transform you into the galaxy’s deadliest defender. 

As a special offer, we’re giving away Hive Slayer 100% FREE, but are asking that you donate whatever you can to the Community Foundation of Southwest Louisiana Hurricane Relief & Recovery fund. Donations and downloads can be made through the [url=https://king-crow-studios.itch.io/hive-slayer]Hive Slayer itch.io[/url] or by going directly to the [url=https://www.foundationswla.org/hurricane-relief]CFSLHRF site[/url]. The fund places a focus on providing food, shelter, medicine, and all other necessities needed to stabilize those most in need and grants for future long-term recovery.   

King Crow Studios is based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The entire world is in the grip of a deadly pandemic, and us Louisianians are dealing with that on top of two deadly and massively destructive hurricanes, Laura and Delta. These catastrophic forces have displaced tens of thousands of people in our area. They have destroyed homes, local business, and lives. 

The impact of the hurricanes has hit us on a very personal level. Our founder Cody Louviere has been traveling multiple times a week to Lake Charles, Louisiana - hurricane ground zero. A Lake Charles native, he’s been working with his own family - his mother, his father, and siblings - to try to save and repair their homes in the middle of these back-to-back natural disasters.

Here are some pictures Cody took from his most recent trip to Lake Charles:

So, to do our part we will donate 100% of the net proceeds from donations made by you, players of HIVE SLAYER to aid in the relief efforts.
